result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: the second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is vertically truncated, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details.

issues.description: The second restaurant card (pizza) in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom. Only the top portion of the image is visible, while the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine type are completely hidden.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container height or scroll position so that the full card and its metadata are visible. Ensure vertical overflow is handled correctly and cards are not clipped by the viewport or parent container.
